edges.reason: msg.sender indexes freeRollPunks to decide how many free rolls can be minted.
msg.sender is the payer and refund recipient in mint, gating who can mint.
msg.sender is the mint recipient used by _safeMint inside _mint.
withdrawFailsafe sends the whole balance to caller-controlled msg.sender via low-level call.
The overpayment refund is transferred back to msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner for setPrice.
onlyOwner guards withdrawTeam against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards withdrawFailsafe against non-owner callers.
onlyOwner guards giveFreeRoll against non-owner callers.
block.timestamp is fed into the keccak randomness used to pick token ids.
mint executes the transfer refund when msg.value exceeds the cost.
mint calls the internal _mint routine after payment validation.
freeRollMint calls the internal _mint routine with the free roll count.
_mint calls useRandomAvailableToken for each token id.
useRandomAvailableToken delegates final selection to useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_mint reaches the _beforeTokenTransfer hook through _safeMint.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the caller-controlled recipient, enabling reentrancy.
withdrawTeam sends the 6% share to oaf using send.
withdrawTeam sends the remaining share to quack using send.
withdrawFailsafe performs a low-level value call to msg.sender.

getCostForMintingPunks multiplies _numToMint by _price.

freeRollMint reads and zeroes freeRollPunks[msg.sender].
getNumFreeRollPunks reads the freeRollPunks mapping.
giveFreeRoll writes the freeRollPunks balance of the receiver.
giveFreeRoll increments _numFreeRollsGiven by numRolls.

endSale sets isSaleOn to false.

withdrawTeam sends the 6% share to the oaf address.
withdrawTeam sends the remainder to the quack address.

_quack is computed as _balance minus _oaf.
_numToMint is added to totalSupply and multiplied by _price in mint.
_numToMint bounds the mint loop in the internal _mint.
_numToMint is multiplied by _price in getCostForMintingPunks.

numRolls is added to freeRollPunks[receiver] and to _numFreeRollsGiven.
_numToFetch is included in the randomness preimage for token id selection.
_i is included in the randomness preimage for token id selection.

updatedNumAvailableTokens accumulates decrements before writing _numAvailableTokens.
newTokenId is returned by useRandomAvailableToken and passed to _safeMint.
success flag from the low-level call is required to be true in withdrawFailsafe.
costForMintingPunks is computed as _price * _numToMint in mint.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _numToMint only exists to drive the arithmetic in mint.
Parameter _numToMint is only used to compute the cost in getCostForMintingPunks.
receiver is only used to index the freeRollPunks mapping inside giveFreeRoll.
numRolls only feeds the arithmetic updates performed by giveFreeRoll.
_numToFetch is only part of the randomness preimage built inside useRandomAvailableToken.
_i is only part of the randomness preimage built inside useRandomAvailableToken.
indexToUse only selects the slot processed by useAvailableTokenAtIndex.
_numToMint only bounds and drives the loop inside the internal _mint.
toMint is a temporary derived from freeRollPunks used only within freeRollMint.
updatedNumAvailableTokens is a loop accumulator written back to _numAvailableTokens in _mint.
newTokenId is a temporary for the token id produced within the _mint loop.
_balance is a temporary snapshot of the contract balance used only in withdrawTeam.
_oaf is a computed payout amount consumed by the send in withdrawTeam.
_quack is a computed payout amount consumed by the send in withdrawTeam.
success only holds the boolean result of the low-level call in withdrawFailsafe.
costForMintingPunks is a transient price computation used only inside mint.
